title: Firmware 4.2 makes the bounce trick obsolete
description: An architect announces a firmware fix. Tests lifecycle: an invalidation closes the validity of the older workaround for the same class.

messages.text: Heads up team: the firmware 4.2 rollout to all transmission nodes installed 2019 or earlier finished last night. Release notes say it fixes the forwarding-state bug after optical module replacement.
So no more disable/enable trick after SFP swaps?
Correct, it shouldn't be needed anymore on those units. If you still see zero counters after a swap, it's something else.

items.summary: Firmware 4.2, now on all transmission nodes installed 2019 or earlier, fixes the forwarding-state bug after optical module replacement: the interface bounce is no longer needed.
items.fact: Firmware 4.2 fixes the forwarding-state bug on these units; zero counters after a swap now point to something else.
